title: Variance
description: For a real random variable with a finite mean, the expected squared deviation from that mean. A finite second moment gives Var(X) = E[X²] − E[X]²; if the second moment diverges, the variance need not be finite.

relations.note: Variance is an expectation of squared deviations from the mean.
Variance quantifies the spread of a real random variable.
Variances measure equilibrium fluctuations, including energy fluctuations in a canonical ensemble.
